Title: Diagnosis of test `testRfc4648Section10Encode`

Details:
The test failure occurs in the assertion `assertEquals("Zg==", Base64.encodeBase64String(StringUtils.getBytesUtf8("f")));`. The expected output is the Base64 encoding of the byte representation of the string `"f"`, which is `"Zg=="`. However, the test fails because the actual output contains an additional newline or whitespace character after `"Zg=="`, as indicated by the output:

```
expected:<Zg==[]> but was:<Zg==[
]>
```

This means the actual returned string has a trailing newline or whitespace character. This is a common issue when encoding Base64 strings as some Base64 encoding implementations add line breaks.

The root cause likely lies in the `Base64.encodeBase64String(byte[])` method. This method should produce a Base64-encoded string without any extra characters such as line breaks for this case. If it erroneously inserts a newline at the end, the test output would include that newline causing the failure.
